checks.title: Has an email capture
checks.detail: No email capture found. A launch page without a capture is a poster, not a funnel.
checks.fix: Add one email field and one button above the fold. Keep it to one step.

checks.title: Has a specific call to action
checks.fix: Add one primary button above the fold with a verb and a concrete outcome.

checks.title: Shows social proof
checks.detail: No testimonials, customer logos or “trusted by” line found.
checks.fix: Add one specific quote with a name and role, or a row of recognizable customer logos.

checks.title: Keeps signup friction low
checks.fix: Start with a single email field.

checks.title: Offers a human contact path
checks.detail: No email or contact link found.
checks.fix: Add a real email or a contact page. Buyers check for a human before they convert.

checks.title: States a clear value proposition
checks.detail: H1 is 4 words and a meta description explains the offer.

checks.title: Reverses the risk of clicking
checks.detail: No “no spam”, “free”, or “cancel anytime” reassurance found.
checks.fix: Put one short reassurance under the button: “Free. No spam. Unsubscribe anytime.”

checks.title: Links a privacy policy
checks.fix: Publish a plain-language privacy page and link it in the footer and near every form.

checks.title: Links terms of service
checks.fix: Add a short terms page. It matters as soon as money changes hands.

checks.title: Explains who is behind the page
checks.detail: No about or team link found.
checks.fix: Add a short “who we are” section. Anonymous launch pages convert worse.

checks.title: Publishes a security contact
checks.fix: Add one when you start handling accounts or payments.

checks.title: Shows a current footer
checks.fix: Add a footer with company name, year and legal links.

checks.title: Declares a canonical URL
checks.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="https://yourdomain.com/"> to prevent duplicate-URL dilution.

checks.title: Has a favicon
checks.fix: Add a 32×32 and 180×180 icon; browsers and tabs look unfinished without one.

checks.title: Measures visits
checks.fix: Add privacy-friendly analytics (Plausible, Umami, or a simple counter) before you announce.

checks.title: Uses a sane heading outline
checks.fix: Break the page into 2–5 scannable H2 sections.

checks.title: Publishes a sitemap
checks.fix: Generate /sitemap.xml and submit it in Google Search Console.

checks.title: Publishes robots.txt
checks.fix: Add a simple robots.txt that points to your sitemap.

checks.title: Adds structured data
checks.fix: Add Organization + WebSite (or Product/SoftwareApplication) schema in one script tag.

checks.title: Links its own pages
checks.fix: Add a footer with links to your key pages.

checks.title: Has readable copy in the HTML
checks.detail: 7.9% of the HTML is readable text.

checks.title: Has a complete Open Graph card
checks.detail: Open Graph is missing og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url.
checks.fix: Add all four tags; most chat and social previews use them.

checks.title: Has a Twitter/X card
checks.fix: Add a summary_large_image card so shared links look designed.

checks.title: Gives buttons accessible names
checks.detail: 1 button has no text or aria-label.
checks.fix: Give every button visible text or an aria-label.

checks.title: Uses landmark elements
checks.detail: main and nav landmarks are present.

checks.title: Offers a skip link
checks.detail: No skip link (nice-to-have for long pages).
checks.fix: Add “Skip to content” as the first focusable element.

checks.title: Publishes llms.txt
checks.fix: Add /llms.txt so AI agents get a clean map of your product instead of guessing from HTML.

checks.title: Offers a full-context file
checks.fix: Add the long-form version if agents need your docs in one request.

checks.title: Lets AI crawlers in
checks.detail: No robots.txt, so AI crawler access is undefined.
checks.fix: Publish robots.txt and explicitly allow the agents you want citations from.

checks.title: Speaks to coding agents
checks.fix: Add AGENTS.md if developers or coding agents integrate with your product.

checks.title: Serves markdown to agents
checks.detail: No markdown alternate or content negotiation.
checks.fix: Optional: serve text/markdown when Accept asks for it, or link a .md alternate.

checks.title: Exposes a machine-readable API
checks.detail: No MCP/OpenAPI descriptor (only needed if agents can act on your product).
checks.fix: Publish a descriptor when you ship an API or MCP server.

checks.title: Answers buying questions
checks.detail: No FAQ section or FAQ schema found.
checks.fix: Add 3–5 real objections (“Is it free?”, “How long does it take?”) and FAQPage schema.

checks.title: Works without JavaScript
checks.detail: Only 656 characters of copy are in the HTML.
checks.fix: Server-render the headline, offer, proof and FAQ. Many agents do not run JS.
